history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#586; borg-reborn-rs #837; follow-up of #576, whose
big run on 3b4924ba had immobile2 at 10 deaths of 540 against shipped's 6, 3 rescued / 7 newly killed). Pilot (RULES 16),
then big (classes-1800 starts 361-900, the same 540 starts as #576; start with big after the gate: shipped and immobile2
should reproduce #576's games except where main moved since 3b4924ba), then small + medium (starts 1-360) on the owner's
go. Three arms, 100,000 turns, all classes, one binary.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json (all shipped 0 in shipped); every cell ends in
death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart; frozen-turn bursts classified. Deaths decide each
arm, never the cases alone.
Report: deaths per class and arm; rescued and newly killed paired by start against shipped and against immobile2; CL and
DL; deaths with an immobile monster adjacent; whether the four #576 deaths (all Dunadan) change; per arm "# Stepping away
from immobile" notes and how many leave the Borg still adjacent, "# Not fixing Confusion next to an immobile attacker"
followed by a melee or a death, "# No step out of reach ... curing confusion anyway", "# Confused: no walk to the stairs",
and "Flowing toward" into the reach of an attacker stepped away from; a RULES 18 bin. Descriptive (RULES 14).
